messages:
Alex: Low-effort proposal: start a sneaky snooze club. No bureaucracy, just 20min naps in Conf C. Who's in? :zzz:
Maria: OMG yes. Is it BYO-blanket or do we raid the merch closet? :blanket:
Jamal: In if there are snacks after. Otherwise I'll nap and dream about snacks. :joy:
Sophia: I can craft a tiny 'Power Nap Zone' sign. Also vote: silent mode or gentle alarm?
CoffeeBot: Friendly reminder: naps + caffeine scheduling recommended. Suggested pre-nap cutoff: 1:30pm. :coffee: (CoffeeBot)
Leo: Maybe rotate so the room isn’t hogged. Also please keep naps to 20–25 minutes so meetings survive.
Alex: Plan: quick Drive sheet, first four get Tuesday & Thursday. Jamal you promised croissants if you join. :grin:
Jamal: Croissants procured. Also optional competitive nap tales (whispered, not shamed).
Sophia: No public snore leaderboard pls. 'Most zen nap' ribbon only.
Maria: Quick poll here: prefer Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri? Reply with day.
Alex: Also flagging @facilities for room usage check.
Leo: I'll make the sheet and post link here in ten.
Maria: Tuesday 2pm for me.
Jamal: Thursday 2pm.
Sophia: Friday 2pm, because it's sacred. :sparkles:
Alex: Tuesday for me.
CoffeeBot: Set reminder: Tue 1:50pm 'stretch & prepare for nap' (bot humour).
Leo: Sheet posted: drive.google.com/sneakynaps (not a real link). Will update roster. :link:
Maria: Secret handshake training to follow. :eyes:
